name: Orbital Fabrications High-Purity Gas Systems Plant (St Ives)
address: Unit 1, 3 Stephenson Road, St Ives, Cambridgeshire PE27 3WJ
description: Manufacturing and ISO class 5/6 cleanroom facility for ultra-high-purity gas and liquid handling components and systems for semiconductor customers (80% owned by Bergman & Beving since Dec 2023, c. 80 employees).

name: Polartherm Mobile Heater Plant (Luvia)
description: Production plant and headquarters of Polartherm, manufacturing all metal components for powerful mobile heaters for industry, construction, defence and aviation (80% owned by Bergman & Beving, Machinery & Equipment division).

name: Cliens Kapitalförvaltning Stockholm Headquarters
description: Stockholm headquarters of Swedish asset manager Cliens Kapitalförvaltning, in which Mandatum acquired 78.4% (via Cliens Holding AB) in October 2026, giving it its main Swedish base.

name: Roslagsgjuteriet Iron Foundry (Herräng)
description: Iron foundry producing machine- and hand-moulded castings up to 500 kg; Industrial Technologies company in Storskogen's Industry business area.

name: Storebrogjuteriet Heavy Iron Foundry (Storebro)
description: Historic foundry (castings since 1808) specialising in heavier iron castings up to 7,000 kg; part of Storskogen's Industry business area.

name: Alfta Kvalitetslego Precision Machining Plant (Alfta)
description: Contract manufacturer of CNC-turned and multi-operation machined components with circumferential welding; Storskogen Industrial Technologies company.

name: Wibe Group Cable Management Factory (Mora)
description: Headquarters and main factory of Wibe Group (cable ladders, trays and mesh trays under the Wibe, Stago, Mita and Defem brands); part of Storskogen's Product Solutions segment.

name: Brenderup Group Headquarters (Malmö Hyllie)
description: Head office of Brenderup Group, a Storskogen Product Solutions company making leisure, professional, boat and snowmobile trailers in Wieleń (Poland), Stigamo (Sweden) and Tyssebotnen (Norway).
